title: 航空原動機
subtitle: Aeroengines
keywords: Cycle Performance of Gas Turbine and Jet Engine 2.Compressor 3.Combustor 4.Turbine 5.Utilization of database
educationalGoal: Students will: (1)learn the basic principles and system components of gas turbines and jet engines (2)learn the cycle calculations and how to evaluate performances of gas turbines (3)learn the performance of components such as compressor, combustor, turbine (4)learn the technical trend of the jet engines and environmental measures (5)research the status of Aeroengines technologies using a database
advice: This is a basic course of the aeroengines (aircraft gas turbines and jet engines) technology. The following subjects will be covered: 1. History, basic principle, and technology development of gas turbines and jet engines 2. Gas turbine cycles and thermodynamic analysis 3. Major performance parameters such as specific thrust, specific fuel consumption, thermal efficiency, propulsive efficiency, and overall efficiency 4. Cycle performance calculation of a turbojet engine 5. Gas turbine engine core components such as compressor, turbine, and combustor 6. Technical trend and environmental measures of jet engines Students will be expected to understand the meaning of technical terms and formulas. Students will be expected to solve the exercises by themselves. Students should be aware of the teacher’s instructions in the class because the schedules of quizzes, tests, and reports may be changed as the class progresses. Students should not be absent from the classes as the handouts may not be received.
books: Textbooks: Turbine engine, JAPAN AERONAUTICAL ENGINEERS' ASSOCIATION Reference books: Jet engine, Morikita syuppan Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: High school level mathematics (especially differential/integral and vector calculations). Basic knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid-dynamics, and heat transfer
